card.name: Supportive care in overdose sections
card.fires_on: The word "supportive" (or "symptomatic" split into pieces) in overdosage sections, right after phrases like "managed with", "provide" or "treatment is".

modes.label: Supportive care
modes.description: The word "supportive" naming the treatment for an overdose.
modes.example: Overdose should be managed with<< supportive>> care.

modes.label: Symptomatic treatment
modes.description: The middle of "symptomatic" after an overdose statement.
modes.example: If overdosage with latanoprost occurs, treatment should be sympt<<omatic>>.
